scope: bounded supervised landmark experiment (one class tower + one green-light keypoint); shadow only; no PPO; no control; no board acceptance

license_gate.main: AGPL-3.0 obligations unresolved; do not start main-recipe training on the assumption the user accepts AGPL
license_gate.backup: YOLOX-Nano Apache-2.0 code; COCO weights/dataset terms still require review
license_gate.rule: no automatic model switch; user decision required before any training start

task_semantics.class_vs_identity: class output 'tower' is class evidence only; landmark_id is identity evidence and requires the uniqueness assumptions to hold, a single candidate, and valid reference handling
uniqueness_assumptions: U1: at most one tower-like instance in the current asset
U2: the central tower is the only tower with a green roof light
U3: this experiment targets the central tower only
uniqueness_invalidated_if: hard-negative frames show a high-similarity green/roof-light structure
hard_negatives_required: HN1 similar structure without central tower
HN2 central tower fully occluded, similar structure visible
HN3 truncated central tower at frame edge
HN4 far small target (green light only a few pixels)

input_output.input: front_rgb v2 observation, 320x240, 90 deg HFOV (fx=160 px, cx0=160); training letterbox 640x640
input_output.keypoint_definition: green roof-light center; visibility encoded per annotation spec; UNAVAILABLE represented as null keypoint + reference_status UNAVAILABLE
input_output.output: class score + bbox (auxiliary) + one keypoint; image bearing atan2(x-cx0, fx)

proposed_thresholds_to_freeze_on_validat.tau_det: PROPOSED: minimum class score for a candidate; freeze on validation
proposed_thresholds_to_freeze_on_validat.tau_margin: PROPOSED: minimum top1-top2 score margin when >=2 candidates; freeze on validation
proposed_thresholds_to_freeze_on_validat.tau_iou: 0.3 (diagnostic); note blind re-annotation bbox IoU mean 0.649 so a 0.3 gate is loose and must not be read as precise box quality
proposed_thresholds_to_freeze_on_validat.tau_px: PROPOSED 3 px (1.07 deg at fx=160); basis: blind re-annotation keypoint difference mean 1.155 px / max 2.236 px (n=17); freeze on validation, never below annotation noise
proposed_thresholds_to_freeze_on_validat.tau_conf: PROPOSED: smallest score satisfying validation identity precision >= 0.95
proposed_thresholds_to_freeze_on_validat.freeze_rule: all thresholds frozen from validation only, before final; no post-final adjustment

presence.tp: GT present AND tower candidate with bbox IoU >= tau_iou
presence.fn: GT present AND no candidate AND not UNKNOWN/REJECTED
presence.negatives_denominator: all GT absent frames incl. HN1-HN6
presence.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN/REJECTED counted outside the 2x2 and reported separately; never TN

reference.false_reference_rate: keypoint emissions on N_unavail / N_unavail (semantic error; target 0)
reference.error_stats: median/P90/max pixel error and image-bearing degrees on correct emissions subset
reference.pixel_scale_note: fx=160 px; 1 px = 0.358 deg; 4-10 px green light = 1.43-3.58 deg; do not claim sub-pixel physical accuracy

identity.high_confidence_false_match: wrong landmark_id with score >= tau_conf / all GT absent frames
identity.single_landmark_limitation: without similar-structure negatives the identity metric is not evaluated

joint.per_frame: presence correct AND identity correct AND reference handling correct AND observation valid
joint.narrow_primary: joint_tp / N_joint_eval where N_joint_eval = positives with complete GT bbox+reference
joint.all_positive_lower_bound: joint_tp / N_pos reported as a lower bound, not as a failure count
joint.bbox_iou: diagnostic only, own denominator (positives with GT bbox); not part of primary joint

training_protocol.warmup_rule: no early stopping, no abort, and no 'joint<0.60 therefore failed' verdict during warmup; validation metrics are logged only
diagnostic_triggers_not_abort: validation joint < 0.60 for 3 consecutive evaluations after warmup
validation metric monotonically worsening after warmup
hard_abort_conditions: annotation QA failure or leakage discovered
validation metric decreasing for 3 consecutive evaluations and below 0.40 after warmup
export/quantization path proven impossible for the intended deployment (when that stage is in scope)
training_protocol.seed_selection_rule: compare seeds on validation only; pick highest validation joint, tie-break lower FP, then lower seed; report all 3 seeds including worst
training_protocol.checkpoint_selection: within each seed, validation joint narrow-primary; tie-break lower FP; never inspect final test
training_protocol.threshold_freeze: on the selected checkpoint, using validation outputs only: tau_conf = smallest score with validation identity precision >= 0.95; tau_margin/tau_px/tau_iou derived identically and recorded
preregistration_artifacts: frozen data split and frame manifest hashes

final_protocol.dataset: sealed final pool frozen before training; >=3 new trajectory families, 200-400 frames, covering HN1-HN6 where constructible
final_protocol.post_final_rule: report only; no tuning, no retraining, no threshold change, no rerun on the same sealed pool; a new evaluation requires new sealed data and a new pre-registration
final_protocol.failure_consequence: recipe judged FAIL for the recorded gates; do not reinterpret as model/navigation/board acceptance

admission_gates.A1_license_decision: user decision required; do not assume AGPL acceptance
admission_gates.A2_independent_groups: existing exposed data must form disjoint train/validation groups; verify with tooling
admission_gates.A4_annotation_semantics: spec can express presence/reference/ambiguity; blind re-annotation differences quantified; proxy limitations stated
admission_gates.A5_version_gpu_export_evidence: version pins, RTX 5080/CUDA evidence, custom one-keypoint export path evidence or explicit UNKNOWN
admission_gates.A7_isolated_training_env: isolated env plan; Isaac venv untouched
admission_gates.A8_sample_adequacy: enough independent groups and evaluable negatives, or report INCOMPLETE

verdict_rule.PASS: A1-A8 all evidenced and no pending user decision
verdict_rule.INCOMPLETE: remaining gaps are team-actionable (more capture/annotation/evidence) and no user decision is required to close them
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: at least one item requires a user decision or an external condition (license acceptance/commercial license/RK3576 board)

effect_gates_proposed_not_competition.caveat: sample size in the final pool may not certify the 0.5% false-match target; report INCOMPLETE when the denominator is insufficient

annotation_and_label_policy.spec: configs/perception/landmark_annotation_spec_v2.json (bbox object extent, visibility/truncation priority, reference_unavailable_reason, ambiguous candidate list, undecidable tri-state, annotator provenance)
annotation_and_label_policy.bbox_extent: visible target structure only (tower body + top light assembly); exclude ground/arena platform/shadow; truncated frames cover only the visible in-image part with truncated=true
annotation_and_label_policy.keypoint_mapping: YOLO 1-keypoint: v in {0,1}; reference unavailable -> bbox + placeholder coords + v=0; v=0 excluded from anchor/coverage denominators; absent -> empty label with explicit frame list; ambiguous excluded from positives; sidecar records truncated/occluded/ambiguous/reference_status/reference_unavailable_reason
annotation_and_label_policy.proxy_limitation: single-agent blind re-annotation is not expert or human independent review; bearing-accuracy validation needs >=2 independent human annotators plus arbitration or physical calibration (pending user/organisation decision)
